  • Constructor Details

    • OmeroImageServer

      public OmeroImageServer(URI imageUri, Client client, PixelApi pixelApi, List<String> args) throws ExecutionException, InterruptedException, IOException
      Create an OmeroImageServer. This may take a few seconds as it will send a request to retrieve the image metadata.
      Parameters:
      imageUri - a link to the image to open
      client - the client that will be used to get image information
      pixelApi - the pixel API to use when reading the image
      args - a list of arguments specifying how to open the image with the provided pixel API. They are specified in qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis
      Throws:
      ExecutionException - if an error occurred while retrieving the image metadata or creating the reader
      InterruptedException - if retrieving the image metadata or creating the reader was interrupted
      IllegalArgumentException - if the image ID cannot be parsed from the provided URI or if the image cannot be read
      IOException
